We now present a central theoretical result underpinning the proposed framework. Specifically, we show that under mild regularity conditions, the variational family induced by the adjoint-co-parameterized latent SDE converges to the true posterior path distribution in the limit of infinite encoder capacity and infinitesimal time discretization. This result formalizes the sense in which the SLDI architecture approximates Bayesian inference in path space.
